caption: The drawing depicts a metallic object consisting of three main components. At the top, there is a small, cylindrical teapot with a spout angled upward to the right and a lid fitted on top. The body of the teapot has a slightly tapered form and a small, rounded handle attached at the right rear. The teapot is mounted on a vertical, cylindrical stand that extends downward and is stabilized near its base by a horizontally positioned handle-like support. All of these components are situated within a shallow, circular dish with slightly raised, rounded edges. The objects are shaded in varying tones of gray, indicating they are metallic and reflecting light. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional elements, and there is a handwritten signature in the lower left corner.
title: Whale Oil Lamp
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
